title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Bryan College of Health Sciences, from quiet study lounges to community wellness resources.

cards.title: Relax in the Student Lounges
cards.subtitle: Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.notes: Visit the dedicated student lounges on the Lincoln campus to connect with peers or take a break between clinical rotations.
cards.short_summary: Comfortable social spaces for students to gather and relax between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The college offers student lounges where current students can spend time outside of class.
cards.source_title: Visit Bryan - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Accessible to current students during building operating hours.

cards.title: Study on the Library Quiet Side
cards.subtitle: 1535 S. 52nd St.
cards.notes: Utilize the designated 'Quiet Side' of the library for focused, individual study in a silent environment.
cards.short_summary: A silent study zone within the campus library for individual academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library's physical space is divided into a 'Quiet Side' for individual, intentional study.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:00 am to 4:30 pm during summer; check for semester updates.

cards.title: Work in the Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: 1535 S. 52nd St.
cards.notes: Access campus computers for individual projects or group work in this collaborative library space.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped space for student research and group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Lab is a space for individual and group use of College computers and has casual seating.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Available to students, faculty, and staff during library hours.

cards.title: Reflect in the Campus Chapel
cards.subtitle: 1600 S. 48th St., 1st Floor
cards.notes: Find a moment of peace for prayer or meditation in the chapel located on the first floor of the East Campus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, 24/7 space for spiritual reflection and meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: The chapel on the first floor of Bryan East Campus is always open for prayer, meditation, and reflection.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week for students and visitors.

cards.title: Visit the Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: Access free academic support, including peer tutoring and study strategy workshops, to enhance your learning.
cards.short_summary: A hub for academic resources and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center provides a variety of free resources and support services for academic success.
cards.source_title: Student Success Center - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Available to all current Bryan College of Health Sciences students.

cards.title: Get Feedback at the Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: Schedule a free session with a writing consultant for help with essays, resumes, or any writing project.
cards.short_summary: Free individualized writing support for students at any stage of the writing process.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center provides free writing support to all students through individualized sessions.
cards.source_title: Writing Center - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Offers both in-person and online consultations by appointment.

cards.title: Access the Blue Healer Bin
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: Utilize this campus resource for essential items and support provided through the college's caring culture initiatives.
cards.short_summary: A campus resource providing essential items to students in need.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Healer Bin is listed as a financial and student life resource for current students.
cards.source_title: Current Students - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Available to current students on the Lincoln campus.

cards.title: Join Peer Mentor Outings
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: Participate in free meetings and social outings designed to help you navigate college life and build networks.
cards.short_summary: Social and professional development events led by student mentors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Peer Mentor Program allows students to focus on development through a variety of meetings, events, and outings.
cards.source_title: Counseling Services - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open to students enrolled in the Peer Mentor Program.

cards.title: Participate in Wellness Activities
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: Engage in free health screenings and wellness-based programs offered throughout the academic year.
cards.short_summary: Campus-wide wellness initiatives and health screenings for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The college provides a number of free health and wellness activities and screenings throughout the school year.
cards.source_title: Health and Wellness - Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Activities are scheduled periodically; check the student portal for dates.

cards.title: Attend Caring with Christ
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Campus
cards.notes: Join this student organization for free meetings focused on spiritual support and community service.
cards.short_summary: A student-led group for spiritual fellowship and community ministry.
cards.evidence_claim: Caring with Christ is an organization open to all students for prayerful support and ministry.
cards.source_title: Student Organizations | Bryan College of Health Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; meeting times are announced on campus.
